scope: Read-only comparison of the five prepared local dataset packages and publication repository with pinned upstream guidance. No catalog migration, data rebuild, upload, registry submission or remote repository creation.

conclusion.prior_official_validator_use: Rashid CLI 0.1.8 ran on all five packages; no prior portolan check execution was found in the build scripts or saved evidence. STAC Node validation is distinct from stac-check advisory linting.
conclusion.fresh_checks: All five packages pass both Portolan CLI 0.8.0 (its compatible Rashid 0.1.8 dependency) and standalone Rashid 0.3.0, with zero errors and warnings. Each has informational upstream-STAC-link advice; LakeATLAS also has two visual-derivative advisories.
conclusion.readiness: Five validated analytic packages are prepared locally. Passing local validators does not establish complete Git-backed workflow adoption, browser usability, public hosting, or registry acceptance.

source_interpretation.git_backed_best_practices: Non-normative guidance: its directory layout, central publish config, and navigation links are recommendations, not independent Core conformance requirements.
source_interpretation.custom_pipeline: Custom Python converters and dataset.yaml as the canonical metadata source remain valid. Neither portolan init/add nor CLI-specific versions.json is required by the specification.
source_interpretation.tool_versions: Versions are those pinned by the consulted skills, not a claim that every package is the newest on PyPI. CLI 0.8.0 requires rashid>=0.1.5,<0.2.0, so Rashid 0.3.0 was tested in a separate environment; no dependency overrides were used.
source_interpretation.manual_quality: Rendering viability and scientific/field semantics need review beyond automated schema and local-byte checks.

aligned.finding: Canonical metadata, build code and evidence are tracked. Bulk GeoParquet, PMTiles and environments remain in ignored local storage.
Source pins, licensing, checksums, fidelity tests and same-code clean rebuild evidence are retained with immutable packages.
The pipelines invoke Rashid, rather than treating custom JSON checks as Portolan conformance. Local HTTP range/CORS and DuckDB checks are distinct from future public-host checks.

aligned.topic: Relative structural links and companion docs
aligned.finding: All five local catalogs carry navigable relative structural links plus linked README and AGENTS documents.

gaps.finding: The repository has canonical records and release evidence snapshots, but no single tracked, directly navigable publication catalog tree. There is no catalog/ tree at the reviewed commit.
gaps.next_step: Generate a separate catalog/catalog.json tree from the existing canonical records and approved release metadata. Keep generated publication metadata distinct from build tools and historical evidence.

gaps.finding: There are no tracked .github workflows or centralized catalog.publish.yaml, and no selected publication mechanism. Existing local validation is not a CI gate.
gaps.next_step: Pin the validator and upstream spec/skill revisions, add metadata-only PR checks, full local data checks before packaging, stac-check advisory linting, and a single configured publisher. Keep publication actions explicitly authorized.

gaps.topic: Repository, issues, browser and hosting navigation
gaps.finding: The five catalog/collection trees lack vcs, issues, browser alternate and hosting about links. The Git repository has no remote, and the packages have no public destination yet.
gaps.next_step: Generate these links from confirmed repository and hosting configuration when those destinations exist; do not invent URLs.

gaps.topic: Browser rendering for three hydro packages
gaps.finding: These packages have analytic GeoParquet plus PNG previews but no visual derivative or style asset. A workable browser render path has not been demonstrated. Their large source files should not be assumed to satisfy the rendering requirement merely because the validator passes. River-plastic inputs and GRWL do include PMTiles and styles.
gaps.next_step: Produce and visually inspect appropriately styled PMTiles, or demonstrate another viable zero-infrastructure render path, in a new immutable release when this work is authorized.

gaps.topic: LakeATLAS field descriptions and dataset-specific usage guidance
gaps.finding: LakeATLAS has 618 asset-scoped table:columns entries (310 distinct names) with zero descriptions. Its field dictionaries are schema-derived. The three generic hydro package AGENTS documents lack worked queries and dataset-specific joining/interpretation guidance.
gaps.next_step: Populate cited field meanings, units, sentinel values and join guidance from the producer documentation, and run the examples as written in the generated docs. Preserve original source columns and values.

gaps.topic: Real hosted access and consumer examples
gaps.finding: Public anonymous access, real hosting CORS/ranges, published catalog reachability and documentation examples against public URLs have not been checked because the packages remain local. Loopback checks do not establish these properties.
gaps.next_step: After an authorized upload, verify public byte ranges, CORS, catalog links, checksums, browser rendering and representative subset queries before registry submission.

gaps.finding: CLI 0.8.0 emits a legacy-note advisory on GRWL, Free-Flowing Rivers, HydroLAKES and LakeATLAS for portolan: fields that the specification does not define. These do not fail either validator.
gaps.next_step: Review and stop generating unused legacy fields in the next metadata release; preserve existing immutable packages and reports.

recommended_direction: Keep one shared repository and one canonical dataset.yaml per dataset. Add a generated publication tree, a pinned validation gate and a single publisher before publication. The template-style publishing approach fits the existing custom converters; avoid mixing it with portolan push for the same tree. Address render and semantic-documentation gaps in new immutable metadata/package releases without rebuilding scientifically equivalent analytic bytes unnecessarily.

validation_scope.cli_mode: --metadata still runs the catalog data pass; source-file classification is not requested.
validation_scope.standalone_rashid_extensions: Default extension validation enabled; a previously unbundled/older schema may be fetched over HTTPS. No remote dataset assets were requested.
validation_scope.negative_control: Both validators pass an intact isolated clone, then fail with PTL-LIC-001 and PTL-STR-001 after removing its collection license. The original package is unchanged.

command_convention.path_normalization: Actual absolute repository paths in command argument vectors are represented relative to the repository root; raw validator stdout/stderr files are unmodified.
